entries.question: Where is new opd
entries.answer:
The New OPD Block at KGMU is located within the university campus. For your convenience, here is the location of various departments within that building:

**New OPD Block Building Locations:**

*   **First Floor:** Department of General Surgery, Department of Trauma Surgery, Department of Oral and Maxillofacial Surgery (Trauma), Department of Medical Oncology, and Injection room.
*   **Second Floor:** Department of Surgical Oncology, Department of Surgical Gastroenterology, Department of PCCM, Department of Endocrine Surgery, Department of Radiotherapy, Department of Clinical Hematology, and Pain Clinic.
*   **Third Floor:** Department of Neurology, Physiotherapy (Neurology), Department of Dermatology, Department of Neurosurgery, Department of Plastic Surgery, Department of Thoracic Surgery, and Department of Medical Gastroenterology.
*   **Fourth Floor:** Department of Nephrology, Department of Medical Endocrinology, Department of Urology, Department of Pediatric Surgery, Department of Pediatrics, and Department of Pediatric Orthopedic.

**Important Note:** Online registration is mandatory for all patients. You can book your appointment through [www.ors.gov.in](https://www.ors.gov.in), by calling 0522-2258880 / 0522-3539333, or by sending an SMS "APPOINTMENT <NAME>" to 8887019134.

If you have specific medical concerns, please consult a doctor at the KGMU OPD. Please avoid sharing personal health details, Aadhaar numbers, or phone numbers in this chat for your safety.

entries.question: Apke hospital vacancy nikli h ki ni
entries.answer:
KGMU mein nikalne wali sabhi naukriyon (vacancies) ki jaankari aap hamari adhikarik website ke 'Career' section mein dekh sakte hain.

Aap seedhe is link par jaakar check kar sakte hain: [https://kgmu.org/job.php](https://kgmu.org/job.php)

Nayi bharti ya recruitment se sambandhit koi bhi notice isi page par update kiya jata hai. Aap samay-samay par ise check karte rahein.

entries.question: Kgmu nursing office ki admit card kb tk aayega
entries.answer:
KGMU Nursing entrance examination ke admit card aur anya jaankari ke liye, aapko university ki aadhikarik website **www.kgmu.org** par "Entrance Examination Notice" ya "Notice Board" section ko niyamit roop se check karte rehna chahiye.

Admit card jari hone par aap apne personal login se ise download kar sakenge. Kripya university ki website par jaakar "Entrance Examination Registration Portal" ya "Notice Board" dekhte rahein.

Yadi aapko vishesh jaankari chahiye, toh aap KGMU ke examination cell ya helpline number **0522-2258880** par sampark kar sakte hain.
